parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM works WHERE status='active') AS total_works, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM works WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS new_this_week, (SELECT AVG((metadata->>'trend_score')::float) FROM work_metrics) AS avg_trend_score;

SELECT w.id, w.title, w.author, (wm.monetization_potential)::float AS monetization_potential, w.source_url FROM works w LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT monetization_potential FROM work_metrics WHERE work_id = w.id ORDER BY metric_date DESC LIMIT 1) wm ON TRUE WHERE w.status = 'active' ORDER BY (wm.monetization_potential)::float DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

parameters.functionCode: const q = $input.item.json.query || {}; const days = parseInt(q.days || 30); const sql = `SELECT work_id, avg(trend_score)::float AS avg_trend_score, max(search_volume) AS peak_search_volume FROM work_metrics WHERE metric_date > NOW() - ($1 || ' days')::interval GROUP BY work_id ORDER BY avg_trend_score DESC LIMIT 50;`; return [{ json: { query: sql, params: [days] } }];
